id: title:Gilbert09:retry transient s3 write errors in the v3 pipeline writer

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification and retry tenacity to S3 parquet writes, supporting warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.reason: The observed changes introduce a wrapper around S3 parquet writes and add tests distinguishing transient OSError from PermissionError, while also adding tenacity-based retries. This demonstrates a bounded improvement in ingestion reliability and failure handling for warehouse ingestion, warranting a score of 2.
